title: 上行：从 token 到文字
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。本章把 L0 的 API 进程上行泳道放大：引擎回程的一串 token id 在前端进程内被变回文字、按请求拆流、流到各自的消费者手上；客户端断连时反向 abort 把请求从引擎里抠掉。
hook_suggestion: 「引擎每步只送回一串 token id——谁把它变回文字？一条回程消息混着上百个请求的新 token，怎么拆回各自的流？客户端读得慢，中间输出堆在哪？用户中途关掉页面，谁去喊停还在烧 GPU 的请求？」（从 Part II hook『一千个并发，怎么让 GPU 永不等 CPU？』+ 本章主题『API 进程上行泳道』+ deepread/api-entry why_chains[2]『单槽 Collector』、[3]『output_handler 分块让出』、[4]『三态契约』、[6]『断连反向 abort』提炼）
scope_note: 本章解读上行泳道：EngineCoreOutputs 过线之后到 yield RequestOutput 之前发生在 API 进程内的一切。主线 = 回程到港（EngineCoreOutputQueueTask → outputs_queue）→ output_handler 拉批分块（chunk=128 + sleep(0)）→ process_outputs 唯一单循环（demux → 增量去 token + 停止串 → 造输出）→ make_request_output 三道闸（FINAL_ONLY / stream_interval / n>1 父聚合）→ 单槽 RequestOutputCollector → generate() 消费 yield。增量去 token 化展开到 Fast（DecodeStream）/Slow（双 offset 窗口）两路 decode_next、byte-fallback UTF-8 边界、stop-string holdback 与窗口查找。边界：回程 socket 侧（PUSH/PULL/解码帧序）ch5 已讲透，本章自 outputs_queue 起步；双轨 id 的出发侧 ch6 已讲，本章只讲回程出口（external 写回 + abort 双轨）；logprobs 的增量累积与 raw 语义归 ch8（本章只留调用点占位）；SSE 格式 ch2 已立（本章 yield 之后一句话带过，serving 层全貌归 ch38）；引擎侧五拍与 EngineCoreOutputs 怎么产出归 ch9；n>1 的扇出发点在 add_request（async_llm.py:L401-L418，ch6 只留了分支名），扇出+聚合在本章成对讲完。

stations_note: 站号 = 一个流式 chat 请求上行段流经顺序：1-3 站是上行登记（add_request 时刻，回程到达前 collector/RequestState 必已就位），4 站回程消息到港，5-12 站是 output_handler→process_outputs 的解包流水（去 token→取文本→三道闸→分发→单槽邮箱），13 站 generate 消费 yield，14 站断连反向 abort。与 ch4 衔接：双登记在那里立骨架，本章展开『先本进程』那半边的内容物。与 ch5 衔接：第 4 站自 PULL 解码后起步，socket/帧序/死讯哨兵已讲。与 ch6 衔接：双轨 id 的出发侧（assign_request_id）已讲，本章讲出口侧（external 写回 + abort 双轨）；ch6 留下的 n>1 扇出分支在本章第 2 站兑现。与 ch8 衔接：logprobs 的增量累积（output_processor.py:L663-665 调用点）与 raw logprobs 语义归 ch8。同步离线面（LLMEngine）与异步面共用同一个 OutputProcessor，差异只在第 11 站的分叉（queue 有无）。

key_classes.name: RequestOutputCollector
key_classes.responsibility: per-request 单槽邮箱：连接 output_handler 生产者与 generate() 消费者。单槽 self.output + asyncio.Event self.ready；put 非阻塞（空槽/Exception 占槽置位；槽满且双 RequestOutput → add() 就地合并，aggregate=DELTA）；get 阻塞等事件、get_nowait 非阻塞快取。构造签名 (output_kind, request_id)——request_id 是内部 id，abort 用。刻意不是 asyncio.Queue（api-entry why_chains[2]）。

key_classes.name: OutputProcessor
key_classes.responsibility: 上行解包总入口：持 request_states（内部id→RequestState）、parent_requests、external_req_ids（外部id→[内部id]）三张表。process_outputs 是唯一遍历整批 EngineCoreOutputs 的单循环；abort_requests 双轨皆可且父请求联动 abort 子请求；propagate_error 把 output_handler 的异常广播给全部在飞请求的 collector；_finish_request 注销三张表。同时服务 AsyncLLM（queue.put）与 LLMEngine（返回列表）两条路径。

key_classes.name: RequestState
key_classes.responsibility: per-request 上行累积状态：detokenizer、logprobs_processor（ch8）、queue、parent_req、output_kind、stream_interval/sent_tokens_offset、is_prefilling、num_cached_tokens。make_request_output 把本步增量变成（或不变成）RequestOutput——三道闸全在此；from_new_request 是工厂（选 detokenizer、clamp per-request stream_interval、detokenize=False 时 tokenizer 置 None 走空壳）。

key_classes.name: IncrementalDetokenizer
key_classes.responsibility: 层级根 + 空壳实现（无 tokenizer 或 detokenize=False）：只累积 token_ids，update 返回 None、get_next_output_text 恒空串。持工厂 from_new_request 三路分派：tokenizer None→空壳；USE_FAST_DETOKENIZER 且 isinstance(tokenizer, TokenizersBackend)→Fast；否则→Slow。

key_classes.name: BaseIncrementalDetokenizer
key_classes.responsibility: 抽象基类：与具体 tokenizer 无关的公共逻辑——stop/min_tokens/include_stop_str_in_output 解析、stop_buffer_length = max(len(s))-1 holdback 计算、update 主流程（跳 stop token、逐 token decode_next、min_tokens 推进 stop_check_offset、check_stop_strings 截断）、get_next_output_text 的 delta/全量取文本与尾字符扣留。decode_next 抽象，Fast/Slow 各自实现。

key_classes.name: FastIncrementalDetokenizer
key_classes.responsibility: 快路径：tokenizers 库 DecodeStream（构造时以 prompt_token_ids 做 native prefill 预热）；decode_next → _protected_step → stream.step；_protected_step 兜两类异常——(OverflowError, TypeError) 吞掉返回 None，'Invalid prefix encountered' 则重建 DecodeStream 恢复（非单调/无效 UTF-8 输出破坏内部状态，issue #17448）。可选抑制相邻特殊 token 间空格。

key_classes.name: SlowIncrementalDetokenizer
key_classes.responsibility: 慢路径（纯 Python 回退，非 TokenizersBackend 或 tokenizers<0.22.0）：以 prompt 预填 tokens 并算初始 prefix_offset/read_offset（embeds 请求退化为占位——源码自注 'cannot be detokenized, in general'）；decode_next 调 detokenize_incrementally 维护双 offset 窗口。覆写 output_token_ids/num_output_tokens 减去 prompt_len（token_ids 含 prompt，与 Fast 路径口径不同）。

key_classes.name: ParentRequest
key_classes.responsibility: n>1 并行采样的父请求聚合器：get_child_info 产 idx_ 前缀子 id + 子 sampling_params（seed 非空时逐子克隆唯一 seed，否则缓存复用）；get_outputs 子→父聚合（流式逐子转发 / FINAL_ONLY 攒齐 n 个一次返回，already_finished_and_returned 防重复）；child_requests 集合决定整体 finished。

key_classes.name: RequestOutput / CompletionOutput
key_classes.responsibility: 对外的输出对象：RequestOutput.request_id 写回外部 id（output_processor.py:L374 注释 'request_id is what was provided externally'）；add(next_output, aggregate) 是单槽合并的真正实现——按 CompletionOutput.index 配对，DELTA 拼接 text/token_ids/logprobs、CUMULATIVE 整体替换、新 index append（n>1 子序列不互相覆盖）。STREAM_FINISHED 哨兵对象（流式输入专用，L200-208）。

key_classes.name: AsyncLLM（上行侧）
key_classes.responsibility: 上行侧三件事：add_request 建 collector + n>1 扇出（L395-418）；_run_output_handler 常驻单任务拉批分块喂 OutputProcessor、stop-string 反向 abort、异常 propagate_error（L657-727）；generate() 消费循环 + 断连/异常路径全部 abort(internal=True)（L577-655）+ abort 两跳落地（L729-738）。output_handler eager/lazy 双启动（事件循环内 __init__ 即启 L173-179，否则首个 add_request 懒启 L390-393——注释原话 'handle startup failure gracefully in the OpenAI server'）。

key_classes.name: EngineCoreOutputQueueTask（AsyncMPClient 内协程）
key_classes.responsibility: 回程到港任务（名字即 create_task 的 name 参数 L1089-1091）：PULL 收帧 → validate_alive（单帧死讯→EngineDeadError）→ decoder.decode(EngineCoreOutputs) → outputs_queue.put_nowait；异常也进队列由 get_output_async 转抛。本章自它起步，socket 侧归 ch5。

key_classes.name: check_stop_strings
key_classes.responsibility: 模块级函数：仅在新增字符窗口内 find（起点 1-new_char_count-len(stop_str)，负索引回看）避免每步重扫全文；多条命中取『完成最早』者（v0.27.x 新语义——投机解码一步多 token 时结果与逐 token 追加一致，docstring 明言）；按 include_in_output 决定截到 stop 串首或尾，返回 (stop_str, truncate_to|-1)。

why_chains.decision: RequestOutputCollector = 单槽 + asyncio.Event + 生产侧合并——刻意不用 asyncio.Queue
why_chains.old_design: v0 AsyncStream 每请求一条无界 asyncio.Queue（历史 e19bce40a~1：`self._queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()`，每条 RequestOutput put_nowait 排队）。v1 初版（PR #9826，2024-11）仍沿用 asyncio.Queue；#12298（2025-01）先在 generate() 消费侧加合并；#15156（2025-03-24 '[V1][Perf] Simpler request output queues'，commit 9d72daf4c，git log -S 'class RequestOutputCollector' 唯一命中）才落成今天的单槽 collector。
why_chains.pain: SSE 消费者会滞后（TCP 背压、慢客户端、事件循环忙）——无界队列把每一条中间 RequestOutput 都留在内存：高并发 × 长生成的中间态全部滞留；CUMULATIVE 模式每条快照持有全量已生成文本，滞留代价是 O(len^2) 级；asyncio.Queue 的 put/get 每次还有锁与 future 的固定开销。
why_chains.solution: RequestOutputCollector（output_processor.py:L45-106）：构造 (output_kind, request_id)（L54-60，aggregate = DELTA）；单槽 self.output + self.ready（Event）；put() 槽空或 Exception → 占槽置位（L64-66，错误无条件抢槽）；槽非空且双 RequestOutput → output.add(output, aggregate=) 就地合并（L67-72 → vllm/outputs.py:L152-181：DELTA 把增量 text/token_ids/logprobs 拼进滞留对象、CUMULATIVE 替换同 index 输出）；PoolingRequestOutput → 直接替换（L73-76）；消费侧 get() 等事件（L78-86）、get_nowait() 非阻塞快路径（L88-96）；generate() 里 `out = q.get_nowait() or await q.get()`（async_llm.py:L599，注释 'avoids task switching under load which helps performance'）。消费者无论滞后多久，每请求驻留内存 O(1)。
why_chains.cost: 单槽 = 慢消费者在 CUMULATIVE 模式下永远看不到中间快照（只有最新态幸存，语义正确但失去逐步视图）；DELTA 合并让消费者收到融合大块而非逐 step 小块（省内存但失去节拍粒度）；错误抢槽会覆盖未取走的正常输出（错误优先的设计取舍）；`get_nowait() or await get()` 依赖 RequestOutput 恒真值——outputs.py 的 RequestOutput 未定义 __bool__/__len__（已核 grep 无匹配），将来若加 __len__ 空输出变假值，此行会静默错乱，是埋着的地雷；close/__del__ 还要收拾流式输入的 _input_stream_task（L98-106）。

why_chains.decision: 回程分发 = 单个长驻 output_handler 任务做 1→N 多路分发，按 VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE 分块并在片间让出事件循环
why_chains.old_design: v0 的输出分发内嵌在引擎循环里同步做（同进程，RequestTracker.process_request_output 逐条 put）；v1 初版 output_handler 一口气处理整批 EngineCoreOutputs（PR #12287 之前无分块，diff 已在 v0.21.0 深读核对）。

class RequestOutputCollector:
    """
    Collects streamed RequestOutputs per individual request,
    for hand-off to the consuming asyncio generate task.

    When streaming deltas, RequestOutputs are merged if the
    producer gets ahead of the consumer.
    """

    def __init__(self, output_kind: RequestOutputKind, request_id: str):
        self.aggregate = output_kind == RequestOutputKind.DELTA
        self.request_id = request_id
        self.output: RequestOutput | PoolingRequestOutput | Exception | None = None
        self.ready = asyncio.Event()

        self._input_stream_task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    def put(self, output: RequestOutput | PoolingRequestOutput | Exception) -> None:
        """Non-blocking put operation."""
        if self.output is None or isinstance(output, Exception):
            self.output = output
            self.ready.set()
        elif isinstance(self.output, RequestOutput) and isinstance(
            output, RequestOutput
        ):
            # This ensures that request outputs with different request indexes
            # (if n > 1) do not override each other.
            self.output.add(output, aggregate=self.aggregate)
        elif isinstance(self.output, PoolingRequestOutput) and isinstance(
            output, PoolingRequestOutput
        ):
            self.output = output

    async def get(self) -> RequestOutput | PoolingRequestOutput:
        """Get operation blocks on put event."""
        while (output := self.output) is None:
            await self.ready.wait()
        self.output = None
        self.ready.clear()
        if isinstance(output, Exception):
            raise output
        return output

    def get_nowait(self) -> RequestOutput | PoolingRequestOutput | None:
        """Non-blocking get operation."""
        output = self.output
        if output is not None:
            self.output = None
            self.ready.clear()
        if isinstance(output, Exception):
            raise output
        return output

def process_outputs(
        self,
        engine_core_outputs: list[EngineCoreOutput],
        engine_core_timestamp: float | None = None,
        iteration_stats: IterationStats | None = None,
    ) -> OutputProcessorOutput:
        """
        Process the EngineCoreOutputs:
        1) Compute stats for logging
        2) Detokenize
        3) Create and handle RequestOutput objects:
            * If there is a queue (for usage with AsyncLLM),
              put the RequestOutput objects into the queue for
              handling by the per-request generate() tasks.

            * If there is no queue (for usage with LLMEngine),
              return a list of RequestOutput objects.

        NOTE FOR DEVELOPERS

        vLLM V1 minimizes the number of python loops over the full
        batch to ensure system overheads are minimized. This is the
        only function that should loop over EngineCoreOutputs.

        If you need to touch every element of the batch, do it from
        within the loop below.
        """

        request_outputs: list[RequestOutput | PoolingRequestOutput] = []
        reqs_to_abort: list[str] = []
        for engine_core_output in engine_core_outputs:
            req_id = engine_core_output.request_id
            req_state = self.request_states.get(req_id)
            if req_state is None:
                # Ignore output for already-aborted request.
                continue

            # 1) Compute stats for this iteration.
            self._update_stats_from_output(
                req_state, engine_core_output, engine_core_timestamp, iteration_stats
            )

            new_token_ids = engine_core_output.new_token_ids
            pooling_output = engine_core_output.pooling_output
            finish_reason = engine_core_output.finish_reason
            stop_reason = engine_core_output.stop_reason
            kv_transfer_params = engine_core_output.kv_transfer_params
            ec_transfer_params = engine_core_output.ec_transfer_params
            if engine_core_output.routed_experts is not None:
                req_state.routed_experts_chunks.append(
                    engine_core_output.routed_experts
                )

            if req_state.is_prefilling:
                if engine_core_output.prefill_stats is not None:
                    req_state.num_cached_tokens = (
                        engine_core_output.prefill_stats.num_cached_tokens
                    )
                    req_state.num_cache_creation_tokens = (
                        engine_core_output.prefill_stats.num_cache_creation_tokens
                    )
                req_state.is_prefilling = False

            if pooling_output is None:
                assert req_state.detokenizer is not None
                assert req_state.logprobs_processor is not None
                # 2) Detokenize the token ids into text and perform stop checks.
                stop_string = req_state.detokenizer.update(
                    new_token_ids, finish_reason == FinishReason.STOP
                )
                if stop_string:
                    finish_reason = FinishReason.STOP
                    stop_reason = stop_string

                # 3) Compute sample and prompt logprobs for request,
                # if required.
                req_state.logprobs_processor.update_from_output(engine_core_output)

            # 4) Create and handle RequestOutput objects.
            if request_output := req_state.make_request_output(
                new_token_ids,
                pooling_output,
                finish_reason,
                stop_reason,
                kv_transfer_params,
                ec_transfer_params,
            ):
                if req_state.streaming_input:
                    request_output.finished = False

                if req_state.queue is not None:
                    # AsyncLLM: put into queue for handling by generate().
                    req_state.queue.put(request_output)
                else:
                    # LLMEngine: return list of RequestOutputs.
                    request_outputs.append(request_output)

            # Free completed requests.
            if finish_reason is not None:
                if req_state.streaming_input:
                    if req_state.input_chunk_queue:
                        update = req_state.input_chunk_queue.popleft()
                        req_state.apply_streaming_update(update)
                    else:
                        req_state.input_chunk_queue = None
                else:
                    self._finish_request(req_state)
                    if not engine_core_output.finished:
                        # If req not finished in EngineCore, but Detokenizer
                        # detected stop string, abort needed in EngineCore.
                        reqs_to_abort.append(req_id)

                    # Track per-request stats
                    self._update_stats_from_finished(
                        req_state, finish_reason, iteration_stats
                    )
                    if self.tracing_enabled:
                        self.do_tracing(engine_core_output, req_state, iteration_stats)

        return OutputProcessorOutput(
            request_outputs=request_outputs,
            reqs_to_abort=reqs_to_abort,
        )

def make_request_output(
        self,
        new_token_ids: list[int],
        pooling_output: torch.Tensor | None,
        finish_reason: FinishReason | None,
        stop_reason: int | str | None,
        kv_transfer_params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        ec_transfer_params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> RequestOutput | PoolingRequestOutput | None:
        finished = finish_reason is not None
        final_only = self.output_kind == RequestOutputKind.FINAL_ONLY

        if not finished and final_only:
            # Only the final output is required in FINAL_ONLY mode.
            return None

        if self.stream_interval > 1:
            assert self.detokenizer is not None

            # Send output request only when
            # 1. It has finished, or
            # 2. It is the first token, or
            # 3. It has reached the stream interval number of tokens
            if not (
                finished
                or self.sent_tokens_offset == 0
                or self.detokenizer.num_output_tokens() - self.sent_tokens_offset
                >= self.stream_interval
            ):
                return None

            if self.output_kind == RequestOutputKind.DELTA:
                # Send tokens from the offset in DELTA mode, otherwise all
                # tokens are sent.
                new_token_ids = self.detokenizer.output_token_ids[
                    self.sent_tokens_offset :
                ]
                self.sent_tokens_offset = self.detokenizer.num_output_tokens()

        external_req_id = self.external_req_id

        if pooling_output is not None:
            return self._new_request_output(
                external_req_id,
                [self._new_pooling_output(pooling_output)],
                finished,
            )

        output = self._new_completion_output(new_token_ids, finish_reason, stop_reason)

        if self.parent_req is None:
            outputs = [output]
        else:
            outputs, finished = self.parent_req.get_outputs(self.request_id, output)
            if not outputs:
                return None
            external_req_id = self.parent_req.external_req_id

        return self._new_request_output(
            external_req_id,
            outputs,
            finished,
            kv_transfer_params,
            ec_transfer_params,
        )

def _new_completion_output(
        self,
        token_ids: list[int],
        finish_reason: FinishReason | None,
        stop_reason: int | str | None,
    ) -> CompletionOutput:
        assert self.detokenizer is not None
        assert self.logprobs_processor is not None
        finished = finish_reason is not None
        delta = self.output_kind == RequestOutputKind.DELTA

        # Prepare text and token_ids, based on delta mode
        text = self.detokenizer.get_next_output_text(finished, delta)
        if not delta:
            token_ids = self.detokenizer.output_token_ids

        # Prepare logprobs, based on delta mode
        logprobs = self.logprobs_processor.logprobs
        if delta and logprobs:
            logprobs = logprobs[-len(token_ids) :]

        # Concatenate routed experts on finish
        routed_experts = None
        if finished and self.routed_experts_chunks:
            routed_experts = np.concatenate(self.routed_experts_chunks, axis=0)

        return CompletionOutput(
            index=self.request_index,
            text=text,
            token_ids=token_ids,
            routed_experts=routed_experts,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            cumulative_logprob=self.logprobs_processor.cumulative_logprob,
            finish_reason=str(finish_reason) if finished else None,
            stop_reason=stop_reason if finished else None,
        )

def abort_requests(self, request_ids: Iterable[str], internal: bool) -> list[str]:
        """Abort a list of requests.

        The request_ids may be either external request IDs (those passed to
        InputProcessor.process_inputs()) or internal request IDs (those randomly
        generated when creating the EngineCoreRequest).

        If an external request ID is provided, and that external request ID
        was used for multiple requests, all requests associated with that external
        request ID are aborted.

        In the case of parallel sampling, a request ID may be used to identify
        a parent request, in which case the associated child requests are aborted
        also.
        """
        internal_req_ids = []
        for request_id in request_ids:
            if internal:
                # Internal ID - this may be a parent request
                internal_req_ids.append(request_id)

                # Remove internal ID from the external->internal mapping
                if req_state := self.request_states.get(request_id):
                    external_req_id = req_state.external_req_id
                    internal_ids = self.external_req_ids[external_req_id]
                    internal_ids.remove(request_id)
                    if not internal_ids:
                        del self.external_req_ids[external_req_id]
            elif internal_ids := self.external_req_ids.pop(request_id, []):
                # External ID - abort all requests in the external->internal mapping
                internal_req_ids.extend(internal_ids)

        request_ids_to_abort = []
        for request_id in internal_req_ids:
            req_state = self.request_states.pop(request_id, None)
            if req_state is not None:
                self.lora_states.request_finished(request_id, req_state.lora_name)
                request_ids_to_abort.append(request_id)
                # Produce final abort output.
                if req_state.queue is not None and (
                    request_output := req_state.make_request_output(
                        new_token_ids=[],
                        # Set pooling_output is not None to
                        # correctly enter the abort pooling branch
                        pooling_output=EMPTY_CPU_TENSOR
                        if req_state.detokenizer is None
                        else None,
                        finish_reason=FinishReason.ABORT,
                        stop_reason=None,
                        kv_transfer_params=None,
                        ec_transfer_params=None,
                    )
                ):
                    req_state.queue.put(request_output)
            elif parent := self.parent_requests.get(request_id):
                # Abort children prior to removing the parent.

            1) Detokenize the new token ids incrementally.
            2) Evaluate stop criteria.

        Return matched stop string or None.

def check_stop_strings(
    output_text: str,
    new_char_count: int,
    stop: list[str],
    include_in_output: bool,
) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
    """Check if any stop strings are matched and truncate sequence
    output text accordingly.

    Returns tuple (stop_string, offset) if matched or else None.

    Where stop_string is the matched stop string and offset is the
    length to which output_text should be truncated, or -1 for no
    truncation.

    When several stop strings match within the newly generated text (for
    example when speculative decoding appends multiple tokens in a single
    step), the stop string that completes earliest in the text is selected,
    so the result matches appending one token at a time. Ties are broken by
    stop-list order.
    """
    if not new_char_count or not stop:
        return None

    best_stop_str: str | None = None
    best_stop_index = 0
    best_end = sys.maxsize
    for stop_str in stop:
        stop_string_len = len(stop_str)
        # Avoid searching already-searched text.
        stop_index = output_text.find(stop_str, 1 - new_char_count - stop_string_len)
        if stop_index == -1:
            continue

        # Prefer the stop string that completes earliest in the text.
        end = stop_index + stop_string_len
        if end < best_end:
            best_stop_str = stop_str
            best_stop_index = stop_index
            best_end = end

    if best_stop_str is None:
        return None

    if include_in_output:
        # Truncate to end of stop string.
        if best_end >= len(output_text):
            # No truncation required.
            return best_stop_str, -1
        return best_stop_str, best_end

    # Truncate the output text to the beginning of the stop string.
    return best_stop_str, best_stop_index

def detokenize_incrementally(
    tokenizer: TokenizerLike,
    all_input_ids: list[int],
    prev_tokens: list[str] | None,
    prefix_offset: int,
    read_offset: int,
    skip_special_tokens: bool = False,
    spaces_between_special_tokens: bool = True,
) -> tuple[list[str], str, int, int]:
    """Detokenizes the input ids incrementally and returns the new tokens
    and the new text.

    If `prev_tokens` is None, this function will convert the input ids to
    tokens and return the tokens and the new text. Otherwise, it will return the
    new tokens and the new text.

    This function will also return the new prefix offset and the new read
    offset to be used in the next iteration.

    The offsets are necessary to defeat cleanup algorithms in the decode which
    decide to add a space or not depending on the surrounding ids.

    Args:
        tokenizer: The tokenizer to use.
        all_input_ids: The input ids. The last id is the new token id.
        prev_tokens: The previous tokens. If None, this function will convert
            the input ids to tokens and return the tokens and the new text.
        prefix_offset: The prefix offset.
        read_offset: The read offset.
        skip_special_tokens: Whether to skip special tokens.
        spaces_between_special_tokens: Whether to add spaces between special
            tokens.
    """
    new_token_id = all_input_ids[-1]
    # This is the first iteration for this sequence
    is_first_iter = prev_tokens is None
    if is_first_iter:
        (prev_tokens, prefix_offset, read_offset) = convert_prompt_ids_to_tokens(
            tokenizer, all_input_ids[:-1], skip_special_tokens=skip_special_tokens
        )
    assert prev_tokens is not None

    # If the new token id is out of bounds, return an empty string.
    if 0 <= new_token_id < len(tokenizer):
        # Put new_token_id in a list so skip_special_tokens is respected
        new_tokens = tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(
            [new_token_id], skip_special_tokens=skip_special_tokens
        )
        if isinstance(new_tokens, str):
            new_tokens = [new_tokens]
        else:
            # This is required to guard against out-of-vocab prompt token ids
            # (for example when using dummy weights)
            _replace_none_with_empty(new_tokens)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    else:
        new_tokens = [""]
    output_tokens = prev_tokens + new_tokens

    # If this is the first iteration, return all tokens.
    if is_first_iter:
        new_tokens = output_tokens

    # The prefix text is necessary only to defeat cleanup algorithms in
    # the decode which decide to add a space or not depending on the
    # surrounding ids.
    if tokenizer.is_fast or not tokenizer.get_added_vocab():
        prefix_text = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_string(
            output_tokens[prefix_offset:read_offset]
        )
        new_text = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_string(output_tokens[prefix_offset:])
    else:
        prefix_text = _convert_tokens_to_string_with_added_encoders(
            tokenizer,
            output_tokens[prefix_offset:read_offset],
            skip_special_tokens=skip_special_tokens,
            spaces_between_special_tokens=spaces_between_special_tokens,
        )
        new_text = _convert_tokens_to_string_with_added_encoders(
            tokenizer,
            output_tokens[prefix_offset:],
            skip_special_tokens=skip_special_tokens,
            spaces_between_special_tokens=spaces_between_special_tokens,
        )

    if len(new_text) <= len(prefix_text) or new_text.endswith("�"):
        # utf-8 char at the end means it's a potential unfinished byte sequence
        # from byte fallback tokenization.
        # If it's in the middle, it's probably a real invalid id generated
        # by the model
        return new_tokens, "", prefix_offset, read_offset

    new_text = new_text[len(prefix_text) :]
    return new_tokens, new_text, read_offset, len(output_tokens)

def get_child_info(self, index: int) -> tuple[str, SamplingParams]:
        """Get child request ID and sampling params.

        Args:
          index: index within `n` child requests.

        Returns:
          (request ID, sampling_params) tuple
        """

    def get_outputs(
        self,
        child_request_id: str,
        completion_output: CompletionOutput,
    ) -> tuple[list[CompletionOutput], bool]:
        already_finished_and_returned: bool = False
        if completion_output.finished():
            if child_request_id in self.child_requests:
                self.child_requests.remove(child_request_id)
            else:
                # child request ID is not available in child_requests
                # which means the request had finished in previous
                # batch step and returned to the client earlier
                already_finished_and_returned = True

        if self.sampling_params.output_kind != RequestOutputKind.FINAL_ONLY:
            # If streaming, just return the current output
            #
            # DO NOT output finished and already returned child request to client again
            outputs = [] if already_finished_and_returned else [completion_output]
        else:
            # If not streaming, aggregate the n final outputs.
            self.output_aggregator[completion_output.index] = completion_output
            outputs = [] if self.child_requests else self.output_aggregator

        finished = not self.child_requests
        return outputs, finished

def _run_output_handler(self):
        """Background loop: pulls from EngineCore and pushes to AsyncStreams."""

        if self.output_handler is not None:
            return

        # Ensure that the task doesn't have a circular ref back to the AsyncLLM
        # object, or else it won't be garbage collected and cleaned up properly.
        engine_core = self.engine_core
        output_processor = self.output_processor
        log_stats = self.log_stats
        # We use a mutable list for logger_manager so that it can be updated
        # during elastic EP scaling (see scale_elastic_ep) without creating
        # a circular reference via self.
        self._logger_ref = [self.logger_manager]
        logger_ref = self._logger_ref
        renderer = self.renderer
        chunk_size = envs.VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE

        async def output_handler():
            try:
                while True:
                    # 1) Pull EngineCoreOutputs from the EngineCore.
                    outputs = await engine_core.get_output_async()
                    num_outputs = len(outputs.outputs)

                    iteration_stats = (
                        IterationStats() if (log_stats and num_outputs) else None
                    )

                    # Split outputs into chunks of at most
                    # VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE, so that we don't block the
                    # event loop for too long.
                    engine_core_outputs = outputs.outputs
                    for start in range(0, num_outputs, chunk_size):
                        end = start + chunk_size
                        outputs_slice = engine_core_outputs[start:end]
                        # 2) Process EngineCoreOutputs.
                        processed_outputs = output_processor.process_outputs(
                            outputs_slice, outputs.timestamp, iteration_stats
                        )
                        # NOTE: RequestOutputs are pushed to their queues.
                        assert not processed_outputs.request_outputs

                        # Allow other asyncio tasks to run between chunks
                        if end < num_outputs:
                            await asyncio.sleep(0)

                        # 3) Abort any reqs that finished due to stop strings.
                        if processed_outputs.reqs_to_abort:
                            await engine_core.abort_requests_async(
                                processed_outputs.reqs_to_abort
                            )

                    output_processor.update_scheduler_stats(outputs.scheduler_stats)

                    # 4) Logging.
                    # TODO(rob): make into a coroutine and launch it in
                    # background thread once Prometheus overhead is non-trivial.
                    if logger_ref[0]:
                        logger_ref[0].record(
                            engine_idx=outputs.engine_index,
                            scheduler_stats=outputs.scheduler_stats,
                            iteration_stats=iteration_stats,
                            mm_cache_stats=renderer.stat_mm_cache(),
                        )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception("AsyncLLM output_handler failed.")

theory.topic: 单槽 vs 无界队列的内存账（为什么不是 asyncio.Queue）
theory.detail: 设并发 R、每请求生成长 L、CUMULATIVE 每条快照持全量文本：无界队列在消费者滞后时滞留 O(R·L) 条快照、字节数 O(R·L²) 级（每条平均 L/2 字符 × L 条）；单槽 collector 无论滞后多久每请求驻留恰 1 个 RequestOutput——DELTA 模式下合并后的滞留对象也是增量的并集（总量 ≤ 一次全量），内存 O(R·L)。代价面：CUMULATIVE 慢消费者失去中间快照、DELTA 失去节拍粒度（WC1 cost）。#12298→#15156 两步演进：先消费侧合并、再把合并搬进生产侧的单槽。

theory.topic: holdback 长度 max(len(s))-1 的正确性
theory.detail: 设最长 stop 串长 L_max。任意 stop 串完整出现前，其留在缓冲里未见天日的前缀长度 ≤ L_max-1。流式时若尾部扣住 L_max-1 个字符不吐，则任何尚未完整出现的 stop 串前缀都还在 output_text 里；一旦完整出现，check_stop_strings 在同一次 update 内命中并截断，被截字符尚未流出，故无需扣到 L_max。-1 的另一个理由：扣 L_max 会把『恰好完整出现』的正常文本也多压一步。include_stop_str_in_output=True 时 stop 串本来就要给用户看，无需扣（stop_buffer_length=0）。

theory.topic: 增量去 token 的复杂度：双 offset 窗口
theory.detail: 朴素做法每步 decode(全序列) 是每步 O(n)、总 O(n²)。双窗口（prefix_offset/read_offset）把每步的 convert_tokens_to_string 限制在 [prefix_offset:] 的尾部（上下文 ~INITIAL_INCREMENTAL_DETOKENIZATION_OFFSET=5 个 token 量级），摊还接近 O(1) 上下文/步、总 O(n)。窗口存在的唯一理由是给 tokenizer 的空格 cleanup 算法提供相邻 token 上下文（decode 串 [prefix:read] 得 prefix_text、decode 串 [prefix:] 得 new_text，相减即增量）——不是正确性必需的全量重解。Fast 路径把这整套窗口逻辑下沉进 Rust DecodeStream（构造时 native prefill），Python 侧只剩 stream.step。

theory.topic: byte-fallback 的 UTF-8 多字节边界
theory.detail: byte-fallback tokenizer 把一个多字节 UTF-8 字符拆到多个 token 上（每个 token 是 <0xNN> 字节类 token），单 token 解码得到半个字符 → 显示为 U+FFFD 替换字符 '�'。判定规则（detokenizer_utils.py:L260-265）：new_text 末尾 endswith('\ufffd') = 字节序列可能未完成 → 本步吐空串、不推进 read_offset，等下一 token 补全；中间的替换字符才是模型真生成的非法 id（照常输出）。new_text 长度未超过 prefix_text 时同样吐空串（cleanup 算法把空格吃掉导致无增量）。Fast 路径对应物是 DecodeStream 的内部状态 + 'Invalid prefix encountered' 异常恢复（detokenizer.py:L232-247）。

theory.topic: check_stop_strings 的窗口下界与『完成最早』语义
theory.detail: find 的 start 参数取负索引 1-new_char_count-L：只回看『本次新增 new_char_count 个字符 + 可能与旧文本拼成 stop 串的 L-1 个旧字符』，避免每步重扫全文——每步 O(新增+L) 而非 O(全文)。v0.27.x 新增多命中仲裁：一步多 token（投机解码/chunked 输出）时多个 stop 串可能同时命中，取『在文本中完成位置最早』者（best_end 最小），等价于逐 token 追加时先触发的那条；并列按 stop 列表序（best_end 严格小于才替换）。截断规则：include_in_output=False 截到串首（best_stop_index）、True 截到串尾（best_end）、串尾恰在文末则 -1 不截。

一批 N 条 EngineCoreOutput 的 process_outputs 是纯 Python CPU 活（detokenize+组装）；事件循环单线程，一口气做完 = 所有连接的 SSE 写出/accept/add_request 全停。按 128 切片、片间 await asyncio.sleep(0) 让出控制权，把『一次长停顿』摊成 ceil(N/128) 次短停顿——公平性换吞吐。#12287 基准（A100/Llama-3.2-1B/6000 并发，ipc-stage 卡核对）：req/s 63.62→67.72（+6.4%）、mean TTFT 229.23→197.34ms（−14%）、p99 TPOT 68.90→47.38ms（−31%）。边界认知：sleep(0) 只让出同级就绪任务，不解决单核吞吐上限（detokenize 仍是单核）。

theory.topic: n>1 扇出账：1 个 collector 服务 n 条流
theory.detail: add_request 侧：n 份 EngineCoreRequest（idx_ 前缀子 id、child params n=1、seed 逐子 +index 克隆）过线，OutputProcessor 侧 n 个 RequestState 各自 detokenize；汇合点 = 每子 CompletionOutput.index（=request_index=idx）——collector 的 add() 按 index 配对合并，新 index append（outputs.py:L159-181），所以 n 条流天然汇回一个 RequestOutput.outputs 列表而互不覆盖（put 的注释原话 L70-71）。流式模式逐子转发（不攒）；FINAL_ONLY 攒齐 n 个（output_aggregator[index]）才一次返回、finished = child_requests 空。

interval=k 把每请求发送频率降到 ~1/k（完成与首 token 强制发），换更低的 per-token 序列化/事件循环/SSE 帧开销。DELTA 语义不破：sent_tokens_offset 记录已发偏移，攒批后一次发 [offset:] 的全部增量——无重叠、无丢失。引擎级 scheduler_config.stream_interval 进 OutputProcessor 构造（async_llm.py:L144），per-request SamplingParams.stream_interval 在 from_new_request 取 max clamp（output_processor.py:L227-229，PR #49754）——引擎级是下限不是覆盖。

theory.topic: 三态契约的信息流：FINAL_ONLY 是『零构造』不是『过滤』
theory.detail: make_request_output 在 FINAL_ONLY 且未 finished 时直接 return None（output_processor.py:L286-290）——中间的 RequestOutput 对象根本不构造、不进 collector、不占槽：省的是对象构造 + put/add + Event 唤醒整条链，而不只是省网络。对照：流式 DELTA 每步必构造；CUMULATIVE 每步构造全量快照（库用户同步迭代用，OpenAI 面不用）。三态在入口由使用面声明（chat/completion 的 stream 二值映射、离线强制 FINAL_ONLY），引擎侧不感知——消费方式是前端契约不是引擎开关。

theory.topic: abort 的异步窗口（断连到停算之间）
theory.detail: 断连检测（listen_for_disconnect 胜出）→ cancel handler → generate 抛 CancelledError → await abort() 两次跨边界（本进程移状态 + ABORT 消息过线）→ 引擎输入线程收 ABORT 入 aborts_queue/input_queue（ch5 双队列）→ busy loop 模型执行后处理 → scheduler.finish_requests(FINISHED_ABORTED)。全程 = 1 次事件循环切换 + 1 次 IPC + 引擎当前 step 的剩余时间——期间引擎仍会为该请求算出有界个废 token。防卡死设计：OutputProcessor.abort_requests 在移状态前给 collector 投一条 finish_reason=ABORT 的终态输出（L500-515），让还在 await q.get() 的消费者立即解阻塞拿到 finished=True 而非挂死。

theory.topic: get_nowait() or await get() 的快路径与真值地雷
theory.detail: 消费循环先非阻塞取（槽有货直接拿、不进事件循环调度），空槽才 await——高负载下减少任务切换（async_llm.py:L597-598 注释原话）。`or` 依赖 RequestOutput 恒真：outputs.py 的 RequestOutput 未定义 __bool__/__len__（已核 v0.27.1 grep 无匹配），默认对象恒真成立；若将来加 __len__ 且空输出 len=0 变假值，`out = q.get_nowait() or await q.get()` 会把合法的『空 outputs 但 finished』对象误判为无货——WC1 cost 点名的地雷。
